summary: CSN filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice to the Market disclosing receipt, on August 13, 2026, of an NYSE non-compliance letter under Section 802.01C because the average closing price of its ADSs (NYSE: SID; B3: CSNA3) stayed below US$1.00 over a consecutive 30-trading-day period. The company has six months from receipt to regain compliance, the Cure Period ending roughly February 13, 2027. No delisting is immediate, and management states ADSs now trade above US$1.00 and that it is evaluating all cure alternatives, including a possible reverse ADS ratio change or share consolidation. Watch the ratio-change filing and 30-day price recovery.
